language.name: English
about.description: A local application for preserving ChatGPT conversations and resources.
page.title: Control panel
backup.title: Analysis
backup.summary: View the projects in your ChatGPT account and the number of conversations in each one.
backup.analysis_failed: The account could not be analyzed
inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.summary: Generates the local inventory of conversations and resources for the scope selected in Analysis. The inventory is stored in OAI-Downloader's local database. It updates the required data but does not download attached files.
inventory.diagnosis.not_object: JSON content is not an object
inventory.diagnosis.no_longer_error: The file no longer meets the inventory error criteria
error.diagnosis_unavailable: Cannot read the errors from the last inventory generated in this folder.
cleanup.title: Cleanup
cleanup.summary: Audit and cleanup tools will be added in a future phase.
system.title: System
system.summary: Check the ChatGPT connection and configure the working folder.
system.cookie_step_7: Copy only the complete Cookie value.
system.cookie_placeholder: Paste the complete Cookie value here
system.invalid_cookie: The cookie could not be used to sign in.
system.cookie_save_failed: The cookie could not be saved.
system.browser_auth_failed: The browser connection could not be completed.
system.manual_connection_help: Use this method only when the browser connection is unavailable.
system.storage_select_failed: The data folder could not be changed
system.storage_help: Paste the full path of an existing folder. The selection will be remembered when you restart the interface.
common.partial: Completed with errors; you can retry
cleanup.modal_description: This operation will remove OAI-Downloader local data.
cleanup.modal_warning: SQLite, local states, indexes, and backup data required to rebuild local state will be removed.
cleanup.modal_preserved: Configuration, selected folder, cookies, and browser session will be preserved.
cleanup.confirm_hold: Hold A + L for 4 seconds to confirm
download.aborted: Download stopped due to authentication; progress is saved
download.summary: Downloads the pending resources for the selected scope using either optimal or manual settings. Files are stored in the corresponding backup folder.
download.workers_note: Threads download projects or the root in parallel, one scope per thread; each scope processes its resources sequentially.
error.download_empty_scope: Select the scope in Analysis before downloading resources.
error.download_inventory_required: First generate the inventory for the selected scope in the current folder.
error.busy: An operation is running. Wait until it finishes before starting another or changing the folder.
error.invalid_folder: Enter the full path of an existing folder.
error.storage_failed: Could not save the selected folder. Check permissions.
error.invalid_cookie: Enter a valid cookie on a single line.
error.invalid_session: Could not validate the session. Check your connection and sign in again.
error.cookie_save_failed: Could not save the cookie. Check folder permissions.
error.browser_unavailable: Could not open the browser. Use manual connection or install Chromium: python -m playwright install chromium.
error.browser_failed: Browser sign-in failed. You can use manual connection.
error.project_folder_collision: Two projects map to the same backup folder. Review their names before continuing.
error.no_conversations: There are no saved conversations in this folder. Run a backup first.
error.empty_scope: Select one or more projects or Root only in Analysis before generating the inventory.
error.invalid_scope: A selected project is no longer available. Refresh Analysis and select the scope again.
error.operation_failed: The operation failed. Check your session, connection and folder permissions before retrying.
error.rate_limited: OpenAI has temporarily rate-limited requests. Wait a few seconds and try again.
error.network: Cannot connect to the application. Check that the server is still running.
error.invalid_origin: The request did not originate from this interface. Reload the page.
help.live_help_toggle: Turn Live Help on or off.
help.next: Opens the next available stage in the process.
help.system_status: Shows whether the ChatGPT session is ready to use.
help.system_connect: Opens ChatGPT inside the application to sign in.
help.system_storage: Changes the local folder where data is saved.
help.analysis_refresh: Retrieves the projects and conversations available in your account.
help.analysis_request_delay: Adds a delay between requests to reduce HTTP 429 errors.
help.scope_all: Selects the root and all projects as the working scope.
help.scope_projects: Lets you choose the root and projects used for Inventory and Downloads.
help.inventory_generate: Saves conversations in the selected scope and updates the resource index.
help.download_mode: Lets you choose between automatic and manual download settings.
help.download_optimal: Automatically calculates workers and the pause between resources.
help.download_manual: Lets you set workers and the pause between resources manually.
help.download_workers: Sets how many projects can download at the same time.
help.download_delay: Sets the pause between resources in the same project.
help.download_start: Downloads pending resources from the inventoried scope.
help.download_progress: Shows total progress for resources processed in this download.
help.cleanup_start: Removes the local index and data according to the selected confirmation.
help.cleanup_downloads: Includes downloaded resource files in the local cleanup.
